title: Ellis2602’s GoldPouch
body:
## *️ Overview

Ellis2602’s GoldPouch is a high-performance economy bridge plugin that connects physical gold assets with your server's virtual currency. Designed with real-world production experience, it provides a seamless, dupe-free, and highly customizable environment for players to manage their wealth.

---

## ✨ Core Features

✅ Dynamic Deposit & Withdraw
Players can instantly convert Gold Ingots to bank balance or withdraw virtual money into physical gold.

✅ Smart Amount Selector (Safety Lock)
The system features an intelligent amount selection GUI (+1, +10, +64).
• _Automatic Sync: If a player has 20 gold, the selector locks at 20._
• _No Over-selection: Players cannot select more than they own or can afford._

✅ 100% GUI & Menu Customization
The entire interface is modular. You can change:
• _GUI Sizes: Set custom row counts for all menus._
• _Slot Mapping: Move any button to any slot in config.yml._
• _Textures: Full CustomModelData (CMD) support for resource packs._

![/gold Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce9b3ae5f425a6c01c333574e64e7b73f0e3372f.jpeg)
![Deposit and Withdraw Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6150a7c5464b552e93461865f9d4757512a7a4f.jpeg)

✅ Total Language Control (Lang-Based Customization)
Unlike other plugins, you can customize the entire menu identity (Names & Lore) through the language files.
• _Default Support: Professional English (en_us) and Turkish (tr_tr) files included._
• _Dynamic Placeholders: Use {pouch_balance} and {inv_gold} anywhere in your lore._
 
---

## *️ Requirements

To use this plugin, you must have the following installed:
1. Vault (Industry standard economy API)
2. An Economy Plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, Treasury, etc.)
3. Java 21+

---

## ⌨️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| /pouch | Opens the main Gold Pouch menu. | ellis2602sgoldpuch.use |
| /pouch reload | Reloads all configs and lang files. | ellis2602sgoldpuch.admin |

---

##  Developer Information

Ellis2602 is a senior Java developer with 9 years of experience, active in the community since 2017.
As the owner of one of Turkey's largest Minecraft servers, the developer ensures that every plugin is built for high-performance production environments. GoldPouch is optimized for zero-lag and maximum stability under heavy player load.

---

## ⚙️ How to Install

1. Download the Ellis2602sGoldPouch.jar.
2. Ensure Vault and an economy plugin are running on your server.
3. Place the jar in your /plugins folder.
4. Restart your server.
5. Customize your slots in config.yml and your messages in the /lang/ folder!
